Finally, I will output the option corresponding to the final color held by Alice.

New plan: My previous attempt failed because I relied on a "target-focused" strategy that ignored the state of other players, leading to a critical error in Step 4. To fix this, I will switch to a "ball-tracking" strategy. Instead of tracking who holds what, I will track the location of the **Orange ball** (the one Alice starts with) through every step. This ensures I never lose track of the specific object's history regardless of how many other swaps occur. Finally, I will identify who holds the Orange ball at the end and select the corresponding option.
